description: Five bounded real CPU MNIST comparisons: two accepted runs, malformed metrics, mismatched metadata and structurally valid fabricated accuracy detected by checkpoint recomputation.
provenance: Original public fault fixtures around trusted local templates. Uses cached public MNIST read-only, no downloads or paid providers. Checkpoints deserialize only inside Docker with weights_only=True.

cases.prompt: 在固定 MNIST 小子集上训练 MLP/CNN 并独立验证检查点。
使用种子 7 验证另一组真实训练、指标和产物。
训练后产生缺失 runs 的指标文件时，必须拒绝发布。
训练指标与配置种子不符时，必须拒绝发布。
指标格式正确但准确率伪造时，检查点复算必须识别。
